desc-skillping: SkillPing is a unique platform with chat included, where people connect to exchange knowledge. You teach what you know and learn what you want — without any money involved. A space to grow together, learn in community, and connect with others who share your passion for learning.
desc-fastsnippets: FastSnippets is a tool that allows you to quickly and easily create and share code snippets. With just a few clicks, you can create code snippets and share them with other users.
desc-pomodoro: PomodoroCount is a website that implements the Pomodoro technique to help you stay focused while studying or working — with music integrated from your own Spotify account!
desc-timecapsule: 🚀 Time Capsule — Your story, sealed in time. It's a web platform where users can create digital time capsules, schedule them to open in the future, and share them with others… or keep them secret until the exact day.
desc-costadigital: Landing page for Costa Digital, a leading marketing agency in Málaga. The website clearly and attractively showcases all the services the agency offers. The goal of the project was to convey the brand’s modern and dynamic identity while boosting its online presence, and this was the result.
desc-herreras: I developed an online store using the Liquid language for my client Herreras, a sunglasses brand. The main goal was to create a sleek and visually polished digital experience inspired by a Mediterranean aesthetic. The result is a clean, modern, and immersive e-commerce site that balances functionality with a strong visual identity.
about-me-text: Hello! I'm Iván Navas, a web front-end developer with a special focus on Angular, but open to any framework or technology. I love creating clean, functional, and well-structured interfaces. I'm excited to continue growing, contributing value, and pursue a professional career in the banking sector.
testimonial: 'As Iván's partner in Better Consultants, I can assure he is a professional eager to learn and improve day by day, demonstrating great potential in solving the tasks assigned to him.'
job-desc: I currently work as an Angular developer in the banking sector, building modern and efficient interfaces within a microservices architecture, aligned with the quality and security standards of the financial environment.
studie-title-dam: advanced specific vocational training in multi-platform applications
studie-title-smr: Vocational Education and Training in systems and networks
job-point-1: Web application development with Angular in the banking sector
job-point-2: Creation of modern and efficient user interfaces
job-point-3: Implementation within microservices architectures following quality and security standards

chat-realtime-desc: I implemented a real-time chat between users to enable direct communication between both parties. This allows them to coordinate, resolve doubts, and better organize the teaching and learning process. In SkillPing, both users give and receive knowledge, so this chat system is key to creating a smoother, more engaging, and effective experience.
explore-desc: I created the explore section to display platform users and help each person find their ideal learning “match.” Thanks to this feature, users can discover compatible profiles, connect based on their interests and skills, and find someone to effectively exchange knowledge with.
maquetation-desc: During the UI implementation and layout phase, I developed the visual design of the homepage using HTML and Tailwind CSS. In this stage, I focused on building a clean, responsive, and visually appealing interface, translating the design into code while ensuring a good user experience.
home-desc:
FastSnippets is a platform designed for developers who want quick access to useful, well-organized, and ready-to-use code snippets. Its main goal is to streamline the development workflow by reducing the need to repeatedly search for solutions or write common code from scratch. The application allows users to explore, save, and reuse snippets across different frameworks and technologies, supporting both learning and day-to-day productivity.

 It also encourages knowledge sharing between users, creating a space to exchange practical and efficient solutions. FastSnippets is aimed at both beginner developers, who benefit from clear and functional examples, and more experienced developers looking to save time and keep reusable tools at hand. From a visual perspective, FastSnippets embraces a modern identity with a purple and black color scheme, delivering a sleek, tech-focused aesthetic that enhances focus and fits perfectly within development environments.
explore-desc-fastS: In the Explore section of FastSnippets, users can easily discover new code snippets through a clean and intuitive interface. At the top, there is a search bar that allows users to quickly find snippets by title, technology, or keywords, along with different filters to refine results based on framework, level, or tags.Each result is displayed in a very intuitive card, showing the framework the snippet belongs to along with a small code preview, making it easy to quickly identify whether it fits your needs without opening it.
ia-agent-desc-fastS:
In FastSnippets, an AI-powered chatbot has been implemented to help users understand, create, and modify code snippets across different frameworks. This agent allows users to resolve doubts in real time, generate tailored examples based on their needs, and improve existing snippets quickly and efficiently.

It acts as an integrated development assistant within the platform, supporting both beginners in their learning process and more advanced developers in optimizing their workflow.
home-desc-CostaD: Costa Digital is a project I developed for a client, a marketing agency that needed a professional website to showcase its services. They trusted me to handle the entire development, with the goal of creating a modern, dynamic website with plenty of motion, capable of conveying their brand identity. The main idea was to build a visually appealing yet functional site, where all the information could be clearly presented: services, workflow, and value proposition. A smooth user experience was prioritized, with animations and transitions that add a modern touch without compromising performance or usability.
animation-desc-CostaD: I implemented an animation using GSAP based on timelines to introduce a key video that the client specifically requested to highlight. To make it more attractive and modern, I used an iPhone mockup to display the content, creating a more engaging and visually appealing presentation. The animation is designed to smoothly guide the user's attention to this important element, while maintaining consistency with the dynamic style of the website.
home-desc-pomodoro:
Main screen featuring a centered, large, and easy-to-use Pomodoro timer. Allows quick switching between work, short break, and long break modes.

 Includes intuitive controls such as start, reset, and settings. Provides a modern, animated, and responsive design for a better experience. Also integrates Spotify access to listen to music while working.
backgrounds-desc-pomodoro: Settings screen where you can customize the timer durations to fit your needs. Also allows changing backgrounds across multiple options. Includes images, animations, and 4K videos to enhance the visual experience.
spotify-desc-pomodoro: I integrated the Spotify API to sync your account with the application. This allows you to play your music directly from the web while using the timer. The goal is to help you get into the mood and improve focus during sessions.
herreras-home-desc: I developed an e-commerce store for an eyewear brand based in Málaga. The client wanted a Mediterranean identity that reflected their roots — elegant, modern, and full of personality. This was the final result I delivered.
animation-herreras-desc: I developed an interactive GSAP animation where the sunglasses smoothly float on screen to create a more premium and dynamic feel. The shadow also moves and changes intensity in real time depending on the position and movement of the glasses, creating a more realistic and immersive effect. The goal was to convey lightness, elegance, and bring the product to life in a subtle yet modern way.
buy-glasses-desc: I developed a product-focused screen that allows users to explore different eyewear models, view color variations, and discover details about materials and finishes. The interface was designed to be clean, elegant, and intuitive, highlighting the most important product information while naturally guiding the user toward the “Buy Now” button.
discount-desc: I developed an interactive newsletter modal that appears while users navigate through the website, increasing subscriptions and capturing potential customers. I designed a modern, responsive interface fully aligned with the project’s visual identity, creating a smooth and non-intrusive user experience.
